sam_sales: Kore MedTech POC readout scheduled Thu 10:00 PT. Need final metrics, slides, and a clear decision ask. Who can own the demo + live prompts?

maria_se: I can own the demo + live prompt walk-through. Will update slides with final numbers. Can someone confirm which eval prompts we used? :memo:

alex_ps: Eval prompts = 'diagnosis-summarize', 'rx-suggest', 'differential-gen'. Pasting the final eval snippet below.

alex_ps: ```
eval_results:
- diagnosis-summarize: top-1 accuracy 92.1%
- rx-suggest: clinical-safety score 88.3%
- differential-gen: hit-rate 85.7%
- latency: median 180ms per token, p95 310ms
- cost: $0.008/token avg
```

eve_security: Security questionnaire still pending — they asked about KMS + enterprise SSO. I left comments in the doc (link: https://redwood.internal/docs/kore-poc-security). We still need SOC2 artifact share approval.

sam_sales: For pricing, they want a committed monthly Dedicated quote. Preliminary from finance: $75k/mo for 8 GPUs + premium support. @alex_ps can you confirm throughput numbers for 8xA100 (sustained rps and tail latencies)?

alex_ps: 8xA100 w/ batching: sustained ~55 rps at 512-token avg, p95 ~310ms. Will add a short throughput table to the slides.

maria_se: Agreed success criteria we aligned on: 1) p95 latency < 400ms, 2) clinical-safety > 85% on eval prompts, 3) no P0 security gaps. We hit 1 & 2; security is the open item. Recommend we present 'green with security caveat' in the readout.

sam_sales: Action items: Maria — slides + demo (owner). Alex — throughput table + eval snippet (owner). Eve — finalize security answers + SOC2 share (owner). Me — pricing + contract ask. Drop artifacts in the readout folder by Wed EOD. :calendar:

deploy-bot: Reminder: readout meeting created Thu 10:00 PT — calendar invite sent to attendees.

eve_security: Pushing SOC2 share request to legal today. Also flag: they require HSM-backed KMS for keys in private deploy. Legal will need to approve SOW addendum for that.

sam_sales: If legal needs SOW language, @maria_se and I can propose a short paragraph. Who should be on the readout panel? I suggest @jordan_ce for product and @nina_support for post-POC ops.

jordan_ce: I'll join for product Qs. :thumbsup:

maria_se: I'll have slides + demo notes by Wed 4pm and tag the version in the readout folder. Will include a 2-slide appendix for security artifacts and a 1-slide cost delta table.

sam_sales: Thanks all — let's converge on artifacts by Wed EOD so we can rehearse Thu morning. If anyone hits blockers, ping in this thread.
